about_the_game:
In this demo version of Spyfall, two players step into a city filled with NPCs. One is the police officer, searching for the spy hidden among the crowd. The other is the spy, blending in and completing secret tasks without getting caught.

🔹 The police officer must watch for unusual movements and uncover the spy.
🔹 The spy must act natural, finish missions, and avoid suspicion.

Think fast, stay hidden, or expose the truth, every move matters.

🔎 The chase begins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200g
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A 1v1 battle of deception! One player is the police officer, hunting for the hidden spy. The other is the spy, blending in with NPCs and completing secret tasks. Stay hidden or get exposed—the city is watching!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Turkish
